design_delta_from_v1.extension_trigger: If unchanged CAL-LEX chooses direct after the first 8 calibration episodes and direct's fixed one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound is below 0.80, consume exactly 4 extension episodes. The trigger is independent of whether fallback happened to miss one of the first 8 episodes.
design_delta_from_v1.final_arm_selection: Using stage1 plus extension when triggered, maximize each arm's one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound on deadline success, then empirical success rate, then minimize mean capped time, then tie priority direct,fixed,conditional.
design_delta_from_v1.runtime_thresholds: Fixed cap, conditional cap and deadline are frozen from stage1 only using unchanged CAL-LEX constants; extension rows never refit timing thresholds.
design_delta_from_v1.nonvacuity: A candidate cannot PASS unless at least one fresh scenario has stage1 direct 8/8 but confirmation direct success <1.0. If no such opportunity occurs the study result is INCONCLUSIVE regardless of other gates.

measurement_order: persist and read back stage1 raw for all five families
measure only extension-triggered families and persist/read back extension raw

measure all fresh confirmation rows and persist/read back before any confirmation simulation

candidate_gates.status_rule: INCONCLUSIVE if nonvacuity is false; otherwise PASS iff every gate is true, else FAIL
